record: National Register of Historic Places, U.S. Arsenal Building, description
facts: The hall measures 122 by 42 feet, with a full masonry basement and an octagonal tower 25 feet across. The two-story veranda runs across the north side and meets the tower in the middle.

record: Arkansas Historic Preservation Program contextual survey
facts: The Tower Building is the surviving U.S. Arsenal building within MacArthur Park and now houses the MacArthur Museum of Arkansas Military History.
